about_the_game:
Extend your adventure with four new realms to explore! Experience an even deeper dive into the mysteries of "Hunter’s Journey: Tears of the Lake" with this thrilling DLC, revealing four unexplored locations, each brimming with fresh puzzles, hidden treasures, and story twists to keep you on the edge of your seat. From a long-deserted miners’ hut to an eerie flooded city, every area opens a gateway to greater challenges—and surprising revelations!

Hone your detective skills by repairing dilapidated relics, cracking coded diaries, and unveiling concealed altars. As you solve each puzzle, you inch closer to unraveling a shadowy conspiracy older than the lake itself.

🏹 Explore the Miners’ Hut: Delve into dusty shelves, cabinets, and secret stashes in search of long-lost records. Solve challenging mini-games to reveal the miners’ hidden past.

🏹 Check Out the Abandoned Temple: The village by the Lake of Tears holds many surprises. While your underwater potion lasts, examine every corner of this forgotten sanctuary and question Agatha. Answers about the mysterious waterman might be hidden among ancient notes.

🏹 Inspect the Flooded City: Venture into a drowned metropolis—brave the eerie wall of human skulls and attempt to repair the ruined fountain. Search through the seaweed-laden altar to uncover invaluable clues.

🏹 Examine the Hunting Cabin: Sift through relics of the past and pay special attention to the antique cabinet. Only by completing challenging mini-games can you unlock its secrets. Don’t forget to leaf through the hunter’s diary—vital records may be sealed within its pages.

With each new location comes gripping mysteries to unravel and powerful items to collect. Sharpen your skills and piece together hidden stories!
